description.fun: Cubone is famous for wearing a skull as a helmet, which the Pokédex says belonged to its mother. It cries for her at night, especially under a full moon, and the skull rattles with a mournful sound. It's said to evolve once it comes to terms with its loss. Curiously, Cubone that hatch from Eggs in the games already come wearing a skull.
description.guide: A small, brown Ground Pokémon that wears a skull on its head, said in the Pokédex to be its mother's, and carries a bone as a weapon. It is shy and often cries at night. It evolves into Marowak, or into Alolan Marowak if it evolves in Alola.
description.tagline: A lonely little Pokémon in a skull helmet

description.fun: Once Cubone has worked through its grief, it becomes Marowak, a tough fighter that wields its bone as a club and a boomerang; the skull is now part of its body and can't come off. It taps out messages to other Marowak by pounding rocks with its bone, and rumour says a hidden graveyard for Marowak exists somewhere in the world, a nod to the legendary elephants' graveyard.
description.guide: The evolution of Cubone, a Ground Pokémon whose skull helmet has become part of its body. Having overcome its grief, it is a fierce fighter that uses its bone as a club and a boomerang. Its Alolan form is a Fire and Ghost type.
description.tagline: Cubone, grown tough, with a bone boomerang

description.fun: Surrounded by Grass-type foes in Alola, Marowak bonded closely with its friends and took on a new form, wielding a bone it lights with green flames said to be its mother's spirit. Alolans once feared it as a conjurer for its dance with the burning bone, which is also how it mourns lost friends.

note.text: In Alola, Cubone evolves at night, and always into Alolan Marowak, wherever it came from.
